title: IT wants your MFA approval
scenario: A message in the school help chat says IT is testing login security and asks you to tap “Approve” on the sign-in notification that just appeared on your phone.

answers.A: Deny the prompt and contact school IT through the normal help desk or portal.
answers.B: Ask IT to open a ticket in the school system before you approve any login.
answers.C: Approve because the prompt arrived exactly when the IT message said it would.

explanation: An MFA approval authorizes a login. Timing only proves the sender caused the prompt, not that the sender is IT.
proTip: If someone asks you to approve their login, it is probably their login.
